note: Belgium 3-2 Japan, World Cup round of 16, 2 July 2018 (90+4). Chapter 1 is keyed from 'Courtois throws' (the bowl out) through 'Off he races' and 'on and on' (De Bruyne's ~60-yard carry: keep the '...' pause so it plays near real time) to 'then the pass', 'Low cross' and 'Chadli scores' (the ball in the net). Chapter 2 marks the feet (red, crossed out) on "Meunier's feet" and the space (yellow target) on 'into the space'.

chapters.label: The winner, live
chapters.text: Belgium against Japan, two all, the last minute. Courtois throws it to Kevin De Bruyne. Off he races with the ball, on and on and on... then the pass, into space for Meunier! Low cross... Chadli scores!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. De Bruyne does not pass to Meunier's feet. He passes into the space in front of him.

chapters.label: Onto it
chapters.text: Meunier never slows down. Low cross, Lukaku lets it run... goal!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: spot your teammate's run and pass into the space in front of them, so they can run onto it.
